title: SWE-smith
input: A supported repository profile and healthy upstream image.
native_output: Mutation patches, issue descriptions and validated SWE-bench-style instances.

execution.runtime: VM sandbox with Docker and Apptainer

conversion.approach: Package the exact defective snapshot, existing reference restoration and upstream test command into Harbor.

deviations: One supported addict profile with original procedural mutations.
Original issue writer uses direct OpenAI instead of Portkey.
Local projection of validation reports replaces GitHub branch publication.
Harbor adapter, restored pristine tests, inverse mutation, removed git metadata and offline execution.
known_limitations: Use a supported repository first. Do not introduce a new mutation strategy or claim arbitrary repository support.

why_this_order: First repository synthesis reproduction; prepared profiles and an existing Modal execution path reduce setup uncertainty.
